title: Notable dreams
content: Ok so this is going to be a long one…the second stickied post on this sub states that we can use the sub as a type of dream journal. I’d like to use this post to talk about my most interesting dreams. Mods if this would be better suited to a different sub please let me know and I’ll delete it. I’ve been fascinated by dreams for many years and I actually plan on going into the field of polysomnography ( someone who works with people that have trouble sleeping. Insomnia, sleep apnea, stuff like that.) In my last post I briefly went over my dream world type dreams. Libraries, aquariums, grocery stores and gas stations. So I’ll leave those alone. I have had a number of dreams that ended up coming true and just a few lucid dreams. Without further ado… Prescient dreams * I dreamed I was kayaking and a humpback whale breached right in front of my kayak. Right after the dream I woke up and checked Reddit. The first post I saw was a video of a kayaker that had a whale breach right in front of them… * I dreamed that I was biking around my town and came across a stadium that I had never seen before, end of dream. That night I drive to school and decide to walk to class a different way. I end up walking next to a stadium that I had no clue was there… (I had just started going to this school and it’s by no means a large stadium.) * in my dream I’m out running when a family member drives by and asks if I want a ride home. I take them up on their offer and get into their car. As soon as I get into the car I pull out a vape and start vaping, something I would NEVER do in front of my family. End dream. That afternoon I’m driving home from work and talking to my gf on the phone. I have her on speaker and I’m holding the phone flat in front of my face, speaking directly into the microphone. I then get a text from the same family member I dreamed about and they ask if im vaping in my car.. they had driven by me and had mistaken my phone for a vape.. * In my dream im walking down the street with my two roommates. One of them runs off ahead of us and goes into our house. When we catch up to her she’s in her room talking to a guy with a beard that I don’t recognize. She seems very happy to see this person. End dream. Later that day I come home from work and walk up the stairs. My roommate, the same one that ran off in the dream, is in her room talking to a bearded man..the bearded man is her ex boyfriend…the exact same guy I had dreamed about. I had met this man once or twice before but he had always been clean shaven, that’s why I didn’t recognize him in the dream. Lucid dreams ** only had a few a these and most of the time the dream ends as soon as I become lucid. * In the dream I’m in a railway station. Not sure what triggered it but I realize I’m in a dream. I walk out of the train station through this massive double door and into a field. I then fly around the field until the dream ends. * little bit of background on this one. I was living abroad for a year and very much missed home. I would constantly think of how good it was going to feel to be on my flight home. I was almost obsessed with this thought for close to a year. So in my dream I’m at my grandparents house and my family is having a welcome home party for me. I’m staring out the window when I realize I don’t remember flying home.. I go to my mom and ask her how I got there. I start screaming at her that I don’t remember flying home. I’m frantic at this point and start becoming aware of the fact that I’m dreaming. The dream switches to where I’m with my mom outside at night. At this point I’m pretty lucid and tell her I’m either dreaming or insane. I remember that you can’t tell time in a dream so I find a clock. The clock face is huge and looks like a Dahli painting. Lots of weird numerals that I don’t understand.i calm down and try to figure out how to wake myself up. I had the bright idea of setting an alarm on my phone before I realize that it’s a dream phone and the idea is stupid. While I’m looking at my phone two buttons pop up. One is labeled Wake Up and the other is labeled Stay Asleep. I start mashing the wake up button and I wake up in my room….but it’s different ..I have a different bunk mate and there’s children in my room..my bunk mate asks what’s wrong and then I wake up for real back in my room.. So those are the weirdest ones I’ve had that I can remember. Sorry for the poor formatting and terrible grammar. Thanks for reading!
